### Regulatory Scope & Public Register Verification
Suvira Immigration Consultants provides eligibility scoring, ECA/ZAB/APS credential coordination, SOP/resume/employment reference drafting, and direct applicant-portal visa preparation. Where statutory paid representation before Canadian (IRCC) or Australian (Home Affairs) immigration authorities is required (Form IMM 5476 or Form 956), filings are coordinated through authorized co-counsel whose active registration numbers are disclosed in writing prior to engagement and can be verified on official government registers:
- **Canada (CICC Public Register):** https://college-ic.ca/protecting-the-public/find-an-immigration-consultant
- **Australia (OMARA Register of Migration Agents):** https://portal.mara.gov.au/search-the-register-of-migration-agents/
- **United Kingdom (Immigration Advice Authority / IAA):** https://iaa.gov.uk/

## 3. Dated & Sourced 2026 Immigration Figures (Verified November 2026)

- **Canada Express Entry (IRCC):**
  - Minimum eligibility: 67/100 points under the Federal Skilled Worker (FSW) selection factor grid; 1,200-point Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS) pool.
  - 2025–2026 CRS Cut-off Range: General & Canadian Experience Class (CEC) draws ranged between **481 and 525**; Category-Based Selection draws ranged between **415 and 470** (STEM, Healthcare, Trades) and **388 to 420** (French-language proficiency).
  - Policy Update: LMIA-backed arranged employment points (previously +50 or +200 CRS points) were removed by IRCC in March 2025.
  - Government Fees (2026): CAD $1,525 per adult (CAD $950 processing + CAD $575 Right of Permanent Residence Fee).
  - Single Proof of Funds (FSW/FST): CAD $14,690 (1 person), CAD $27,297 (family of 4).
  - Official Source: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/corporate/mandate/policies-operational-instructions-agreements/ministerial-instructions/express-entry-rounds.html
- **Australia General Skilled Migration (Subclass 189 / 190 / 491):**
  - Statutory Pool Entry Minimum: **65 points** on the Department of Home Affairs SkillSelect grid.
  - Competitive 2025–2026 Invitation Range: **80 to 95+ points** across ICT, Engineering, Healthcare, and Trade occupations.
  - State/Regional Bonus Points: +5 points (Subclass 190 State Nomination); +15 points (Subclass 491 Regional Provisional).
  - Government Primary Visa Charge (FY 2025–2026): AUD $4,770 (primary applicant), AUD $2,385 (adult dependent), AUD $1,190 (child).
  - Official Source: https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/working-in-australia/skillselect/invitation-rounds
- **Germany Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte — § 20a AufenthG):**
  - Eligibility: Direct recognition ("Fachkraft" via Anabin H+ / ZAB) OR **minimum 6 points** on the statutory Chancenkarte points grid (with foreign degree + 2 years study + German A1 or English B2 CEFR).
  - Financial Proof (2026): **€1,091 per month (€13,092 per year)** in a German Blocked Account (Sperrkonto) or formal Declaration of Commitment (Verpflichtungserklärung).
  - Work Rights: 20 hours/week part-time employment + unlimited 2-week trial jobs (Probearbeit) with skilled employers.
  - Official Source: https://www.make-it-in-germany.com/en/visa-residence/types/job-search-opportunity-card
- **Study Abroad Key Financial & Post-Study Work Rules (2026):**
  - **Canada Study Visa:** CAD $20,635 GIC living proof (outside Quebec) + Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL); up to 3-year PGWP at PGWP-eligible DLIs.
  - **Australia Study Visa (Subclass 500):** AUD $29,710/year living cost benchmark + Genuine Student (GS) assessment; 2–4 year Subclass 485 Post-Study Work stream.
  - **UK Student Visa:** £1,483/month (London, 9 months = £13,347) or £1,136/month (outside London, 9 months = £10,224) held for 28 consecutive days; 2-year Graduate Route (PSW) (3 years for PhDs).
  - **Germany Study Visa:** €11,904/year (€992/month) student blocked account + APS India certificate; 18-month post-study job-seeker residence permit.
  - **USA F-1 Student Visa:** Form I-20 + SEVIS I-901 ($350) + DS-160 ($185); 12-month OPT + 24-month STEM OPT extension (36 months total).
  - **Ireland Stamp 2 Study Visa:** €10,000 minimum living funds + private medical insurance; 24-month Stamp 1G Third Level Graduate Programme for Master's graduates.
  - **New Zealand Fee Paying Student Visa:** NZ$20,000/year living funds via ANZ Funds Transfer Scheme (FTS); up to 3-year Post-Study Work Visa for Level 7+ degrees.
